blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Customs (BOC) will look into strengthening its measures to avoid future attempts to smuggle illegal goods into the country using private planes and hangars, its commissioner Ariel Nepomuceno said on Wednesday. Nepomuceno made this statement after foreign authorities reported that a Filipino passenger allegedly smuggled P521 kilograms of suspected shabu from Laos bound for Manila via private jet. The Civil Aviation Authority of the Philippines said that the private jet did not enter the Philippine airspace.
